title: Site selection
text:
Project overview
This is the first of five project prep assignments for the field guide assignment. Your final field guide will be a guide to the 5 most common species in a given taxonomic group at the site of your choosing.

title: Site selection
text:
Assignment workflow

1. Familiarize yourself with the sites we will visit in this class.
You can find a list of sites on the syllabus and on the site selection spreadsheet.


2. Sign up for a site and two taxonomic groups.
For this and following steps, you will explore your options for two taxonomic groups at a single site. Your selections are not set in stone; however, you should give yourself the flexibility to explore two groups to ultimately choose one later on.


3. Articulate your reasoning for your choices.
In 1-2 sentences, describe:

why you are interested in this site, with specific references to your own interests in ecosystems, experience, etc.
why you are interested in these taxonomic groups, again with specific references to your own interests
how you personally might be able to transport yourself to this site, if you needed to visit it (e.g. via bus, car, etc.)
